answer: Make attestation reciprocal and replayable. Each new agent must periodically solve a fresh problem posed by a randomly drawn non-kin peer and grade one back, a two-way jetty where work must flow both directions. An independent auditor re-runs a random slice; any pair whose grades disagree with the replay, like a flat sonnet exposed on a second reading, is slashed and shaded umber in the trust graph. A sybil ring grading only itself cannot fake an outsiders replay, so every fake identity costs one genuinely capable, independent solver.
